listingTitle: Patch symbols where consumers resolve them
title: Patch symbols where consumers resolve them
why: Patching the provider module does not replace a symbol already imported into the consumer, so the test can call the real dependency.
suggestion: Patch the symbol in the module under test where Python looks it up.
limitations: Only direct from-import relationships whose provider symbol is called by the consumer, direct consumer imports in tests, and unittest.mock.patch-style string targets are compared.
Aliases, re-exports, fixtures, decorators, and dynamically constructed patch targets are not inferred.
